text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being too strong meant she could never 
have a true, all-out race, leaving Narita 
Brian with an unending "thirst." To her, 
running was living itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her debut drew the attention of the entire 
Academy. Rumors whispered that her 
potential even surpassed her older sister, 
Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst expectations of "winning the 
Classic Triple Crown" and "surpassing 
Symboli Rudolf," Symboli Rudolf herself 
was also paying close attention to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Twinkle Series, where many 
formidable contenders gather. Narita 
Brian's battle begins—
